name: tecjustica-sigilo
description: Anonimizador de PII para processos judiciais brasileiros

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron-ts && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build:dist: npm run fetch:ocr-models && npm run sync:backend && npm run check:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.check:backend: bash scripts/fetch-ocr-models.sh --check && bash scripts/sync-backend.sh --check && bash scripts/smoke-backend.sh
